remarks:
A Hidden Gem at Rockville Lake!
Escape to your own little piece of paradise at beautiful Rockville Lake in Belfast, NY. Tucked away on a private parcel with wonderful separation from neighboring properties, this charming retreat offers peace, privacy and an absolutely gorgeous view of the lake.
The property features a small shed/camp with a screened-in porch — the perfect spot for morning coffee, an afternoon book or relaxing in the evening while enjoying the sights and sounds of the lake. Even better, the property already has 200-amp electric service, giving the next owner plenty of possibilities.
Rockville Lake is a picturesque 33-acre lake known for its quiet setting, kayaking and fishing. It also has a fascinating connection to local history: the lake was originally created to provide water for the Genesee Valley Canal, and the Rockville name comes from a nearby rock quarry that supplied stone for the canal’s locks. 
Just a short walk away is the Genesee Valley Greenway State Park, a scenic multi-use trail following the former Genesee Valley Canal and Pennsylvania Railroad corridor. Today the Greenway stretches for approximately 90 miles, winding through forests, farmland, wetlands and historic communities — perfect for walking, biking, exploring nature and enjoying the outdoors. 
Whether you’re casting a fishing line, taking in the lake view, relaxing on the screened porch or heading out for a walk along the Greenway, this is the kind of property that lets you truly unplug and get away from it all.
Property is owned by New York State licensed real esate brokers.
Camera on premises.
